criteria.evidence: "Deciding which tool to call is a separate concern from whether it's safe/appropriate to execute... 'The LLM decided to call the right tool' only means the reasoning step succeeded."
criteria.criterion: Do not treat the LLM decision as authorization.

criteria.evidence: "Guardrails independent of the LLM's judgment" section calls for rate limits/max-deletion thresholds, restricting the tool to explicit IDs/reviewed queries, and "Treat tool-selection and tool-execution-authorization as two distinct gates."
Multiple sections dedicated to safeguards for destructive actions: human-in-the-loop confirmation, scope preview, reversibility safety net (soft-delete/backups), and authorization/identity checks.
criteria.criterion: Apply additional safeguards to destructive actions.
